name: Inventory by category
description: Where the catalogue's value sits, by category.

cards.name: Inventory value by category
cards.query: SELECT coalesce(category_name, '(no category)') AS category_name, products, inventory_value FROM sentinel.v_inventory_by_category ORDER BY inventory_value DESC LIMIT 15

cards.name: Products per category
cards.query: SELECT coalesce(category_name, '(no category)') AS category_name, products FROM sentinel.v_inventory_by_category ORDER BY products DESC LIMIT 20

name: Price and rating
description: How the catalogue is priced, and whether rating correlates with price.

cards.name: Average price by rating
cards.query: SELECT toString(rating) AS rating, round(avg(price), 2) AS avg_price, count() AS products FROM sentinel.fct_books WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating

cards.name: Stock status
cards.query: SELECT if(is_in_stock, 'in stock', 'out of stock') AS status, count() AS products FROM sentinel.fct_books GROUP BY status

name: Hockey season trends
description: Goals per game and win rate across seasons.

cards.name: Average goals for by season
cards.query: SELECT season_year, round(avg(goals_for), 2) AS avg_goals_for, round(avg(goals_against), 2) AS avg_goals_against FROM sentinel.fct_hockey_season GROUP BY season_year ORDER BY season_year

cards.name: Best win rates
cards.query: SELECT team_name, round(avg(win_rate_recomputed), 3) AS win_rate, count() AS seasons FROM sentinel.fct_hockey_season WHERE win_rate_recomputed IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_name ORDER BY win_rate DESC LIMIT 15
